name: Surgery_Planner
description: Automated surgery and embryo transfer scheduling plugin. Provides a Gantt-chart-based planner with configurable recovery rules, weekday constraints, blocked days, animal eligibility filtering, manual adjustments, calendar highlighting, and export to CSV, Excel, PNG, and JSON.
